structured.feedback: Good overall. At about 190 words, the description meets the length limit and has clear subheadings. It covers the vegan and "free-from" selling points without overpromising, and it leaves out the reviewers' complaints about color staying power and smell. It avoids made-up quotes and links and ends with a call to action. Two small issues: "is formulated" appears twice in passive voice, and features and benefits are mixed within each section instead of being labeled separately.
